maitri_chapter2_verse1.title: Maitri Chapter 2 Verse 1
maitri_chapter2_verse1.introduction: This verse belongs to Maitri, Chapter 2.
maitri_chapter2_verse1.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Maitri Upanishad, Chapter 2, Verse 1, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
maitri_chapter2_verse1.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
